title: Veryclear
tagline: Scriptable ERC7730 descriptions for Ethereum transactions.
description: A DSL which allows to describe how to understand transactions for humans. It takes a transaction calldata and produces a natural language template with holes that can be filled on an edge device like a ledger.
how_its_made: A DSL in lean produces zk circuits allowing to verify transactions. This circuit allows to generate proofs on the frontend but must be verified on the edge device.
auto_summary: A Next.js app and Ledger-related prototype that decodes transaction calldata into human-readable signing templates with zk-proof-assisted verification.
